messages.text: where is the open your app button is it ready?

The OPEN APP button is already built and working — it's been part of the app since the launch screen was added. Here's where to find it:

When you first open the app, you don't see the tape deck right away. Instead you see a welcome screen with the word "CASSETTE" at the top, a little spinning tape animation in the middle, and a big chunky button that says **▶ OPEN APP**. Tap that button and the welcome screen fades away, revealing your Walkman (or carry unit on a tablet).

The reason it exists: phones won't let any app play sound until you've touched the screen at least once — it's a rule built into iPhone Safari and Android Chrome. That first tap on OPEN APP "wakes up" the sound system, so when you later press PLAY, your music actually plays instead of failing silently. It also tries to switch to full-screen so the app fills your phone like a real device.

If you're not seeing it, you may have opened the app before and it's just showing the deck — try reloading the page and the launch screen appears again.
